Messages.Author: Judith Iscariot Grunberger
Messages.Body:
What happens to the effects of Malkavian Derangement: Paranoia if it is
put on a vampire that is only a Malk Antitribu as a result of being
Deranged, and then the Derange is removed?

Yes, I realize that a Paranoid Deranged vampire cannot take the action
required to move the Derange, but what if the person who played the
Derange is ousted and the Derange disappears, but the Paranoia was played
by someone else who was not ousted?

The Golden Rule of Card Ownership messing everything up again...

--Judy

Messages.Author: Justin Fang
Messages.Body:
In article <65i43m$ogh$1...@nntp-2.io.com>,

Judith "Iscariot" Grunberger <jcoo...@pentagon.io.com> wrote:
>What happens to the effects of Malkavian Derangement: Paranoia if it is
>put on a vampire that is only a Malk Antitribu as a result of being
>Deranged, and then the Derange is removed?

Nothing. Card text:
"Put this card on a Malkavian antitribu. The vampire with this card cannot
attempt actions."

The card only cares about the clan of the vampire when played; after that it
doesn't matter.

--
